_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the integrity judge returned them, round 1; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register met; models primitive and the audition's polish repairs not carried out: cover boxes, 5's flat band and prism slips, 6 stock office art, 3's plates textured not lit, 8 stripes, 2 a stub and blank band, 4 a mannequin before a shed. 7 is the best measured frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck, one world, two working devices; reliefs flatter; 6's warm desk off vocabulary; band tan on 9.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; c9's 'on automated rigs' dropped on 9 and in the caption; c7's 'can perform' printed as 'now do'; c26's 'would usually help' turned to 'used to'; c3 quoted in the caption but not listed in the first comment; 3's plates are not lit.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and roughly where; nothing actionable; the accountability turn lives only in the caption.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 and 3 pay; 5 nearly repeats 1; 7 a detour.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good Texan lines; 'Reuters reported' on six frames and 'drawn to illustrate' on three.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Racks, lateral section and worker at a gate repeat no. 68; ten of twenty repeats no. 69; floodlit world repeats nos. 67 and 59.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stock office art and a starfield window, no contractor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A rig control display of the floor camera, the lit floor in the window, the contractor's shoulder and vest.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Rounded boxes sitting on the pipe; no die pads, loom or grime.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Jaws wrapping the joint with die pads and hairline shadows, a loom, grime.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Tread plates textured, not lit; grating a flat stripe; 'the rest' outside the safe zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A keyMask pool so the three tread plates are clearly brighter; move 'the rest' inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stripes; the lowest joints under the footer.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: All 20 joints and both beams above the footer; stronger casts.
The cover's paint; slip dies that cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A floating stub; blank sign band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The full stand out of the top edge; letter the band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin before a shed, stand base hidden.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The worker beside the stand's base in one pool.
